public.text: The proposed equity mechanisms focus on representation within governance bodies but do not require assessment of actual distributional effects arising from architecture decisions.
public.suggestedRevision: Require an equity-impact assessment for major decisions, examining who gains access, who bears data-entry and compliance burdens, who may be excluded, and whether benefits and risks are distributed fairly across regions and population groups.
